text.what: Germany's warmest vineyards, in the Rhine rift between the Black Forest and the Vosges, facing Alsace across the river. Pinot in its three colours covers most of it.
text.how: Spätburgunder alone took 36.8% of Baden's vineyards in 2008 — 5,855 hectares — with grauburgunder and weissburgunder adding another fifth. The Kaiserstuhl, an old volcano on the valley floor, ripens the fullest of it.

kin.as: Spätburgunder: more than a third of the region's vines.
Same rift valley, other bank, similar size.
